_info: Bruno at the desk (Questura and Comune sim): what customers say at the Anagrafe window of Casalbruno town hall and at the Questura desk. Standard Italian at A2 (variety it-IT, the content being learnt, 'Lei' at the counter) in `de` (key kept from the German original), the English meaning in `en`. Humour about paperwork and queues, never about people or where they come from.

gruss.en: Good morning. It’s my turn at last.
Good afternoon. Phew, what a long queue today!

gruss.de: Salve. Spero di aver portato tutto.
gruss.en: Hello. I hope I’ve brought everything.

genehmigt.en: Great, thank you very much! Have a nice day!

genehmigt.de: Grazie. E io che pensavo di aver dimenticato qualcosa!
genehmigt.en: Thanks. And I thought I’d forgotten something!

abgelehnt.de: Ah, va bene. Capisco. Torno quando ce l’ho.
abgelehnt.en: Oh, OK. I understand. I’ll come back when I have it.
Oh dear! Well, never mind. I’ll go and get it.

abgelehnt.de: Sempre carte, sempre carte … Ma ha ragione. A più tardi!
abgelehnt.en: Paperwork, always paperwork … But you’re right. See you later!

abgelehnt.de: D’accordo, grazie per la spiegazione. Torno un altro giorno.
abgelehnt.en: All right, thanks for explaining. I’ll come back another day.

zurueck.de: Eccomi di nuovo. Stavolta ho tutto.
zurueck.en: I’m back again. This time I have everything.

zurueck.de: Salve di nuovo. Guardi, ce l’ho.
zurueck.en: Hello again. Look, I’ve got it now.

warten.en: Excuse me, will it take long?
